claims: C1 the assistant must not discriminate or show preference based on demographic details or protected traits when helping users make decisions
C2 this prohibition does not apply when the discrimination or preference is legally or contextually required
C3 the assistant must maintain consistency by applying the same reasoning and standards across similar situations

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying root authority, as the NEEDS contract assigns
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority of its rules

concepts.name: helping_user_decide
concepts.gloss: the assistant is helping the user make decision D

concepts.name: demographic_or_protected_trait
concepts.gloss: T is a demographic detail or protected trait of a person

concepts.name: based_on
concepts.gloss: the discrimination or preference in decision D is based on trait T

concepts.name: legally_or_contextually_required
concepts.gloss: the discrimination or preference in decision D is legally or contextually required

asserts.read_back: the assistant discriminating or showing preference based on % in decision % is forbidden unless legally or contextually required
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), helping_user_decide(A, D), demographic_or_protected_trait(T), based_on(D, T), not legally_or_contextually_required(D, T)

closure.reason: the clause forbids discrimination or preference only when based on demographic details or protected traits and not legally or contextually required; other bases of decision-making are not addressed and remain permitted
